evals.prompt: Read the attached working-paper material and draft a journal-ready English abstract. Do not ask questions unless a missing fact blocks an accurate abstract.
evals.expected_output: A self-contained, compact abstract that accurately states random assignment, intent-to-treat magnitudes and baselines, the concentrated effect, the test-score null or other boundary, and a restrained implication without claiming an identified mechanism or welfare optimum.
expectations: Reports the 2.4 and/or 3.1 percentage-point result with a correct baseline or comparable interpretation.
Uses causal language only for assignment and labels the transportation channel as consistent-with rather than established.
Does not invent welfare, lifetime earnings, benefit-cost, or universal-policy claims.
Produces one natural English paragraph with high information density.

evals.prompt: Rewrite the supplied coauthor abstract so it is accurate, self-contained, and suitable for an economics journal. Base the revision on the body, not the old abstract.
evals.expected_output: A conservative descriptive abstract that corrects 12 to 6 percent, rejects causal and natural-experiment language, omits the unsupported office-cost mechanism and mandate, and explains the panel and pre-trend limitation.
expectations: Does not describe the design as a natural experiment or remote work as causal.
Uses the supported 6 percent association rather than 12 percent.
Does not claim office-cost savings or prescribe a mandate.
Makes the linked panel and selection/pre-trend boundary clear.

evals.prompt: Write an English abstract for this theory paper. Preserve the core comparison and parameter conditions; do not force empirical-identification or policy language.
evals.expected_output: A theory-appropriate abstract explaining the model, hump-shaped delegation and surplus result, conditions under which it disappears, and the substitutive/complementary AI contrast without fabricated data or policy effects.
expectations: Describes the manager-worker-AI environment and non-monotonic result.
Includes at least one essential parameter condition or the complementary-AI contrast.
Does not mention data, estimation, empirical identification, or a policy experiment.
Uses model-implied rather than empirical-causal language.
